name: help
description: Show the complete command catalogue and choose the workflow for the task.

name: status
description: Check the selected workspace, installed tools, and requested org connections.

name: context
description: Load the selected client, current task, and relevant saved context.

name: new-client
description: Create a private client workspace and establish a useful engagement baseline.

name: connect-org
description: Connect Salesforce using the existing CLI or available host integration.

name: diagnose
description: Diagnose org, tool, deployment, context or access issues and carry through authorized fixes.

name: triage-alert
description: Turn a Salesforce flow or Apex error notification into cause, fix and verification.

name: audit-org
description: Audit an org across configuration, automation, access, data and operational health.

name: compare-orgs
description: Compare two orgs or an org and baseline to explain meaningful differences.

name: field-audit
description: Review field metadata, population and dependencies for cleanup or data-quality work.

name: flow-analyzer
description: Explain, review and improve a Flow from its current definition and actual behavior.

name: preflight-org
description: Resolve the intended org and relevant metadata before live work.

name: retrieve-current
description: Retrieve current metadata, preserve the baseline and stage an editable proposal.

name: prep-changeset
description: Prepare a dependency-aware deployment packet from the actual change.

name: gift-payments
description: Design a record-triggered flow that keeps NPSP payments and gift batches in sync.

name: grants-outbound-funds
description: Build the automation that turns an approved Outbound Funds funding request into award records.

name: prep-migration
description: Plan and execute scoped data migration with reconciliation and restoration of temporary settings.

name: validate-change
description: Validate the exact proposed change with relevant static, deployment and functional checks.

name: verify-change
description: Verify the actual deployed or configured outcome and record remaining uncertainty.

name: sandbox-refresh
description: Reconnect and restore the intended sandbox configuration after an actual refresh.

name: security-review
description: Review object, field and record access for the intended users and business process.

name: snapshot
description: Capture a scoped point-in-time baseline, distinguishing reference evidence from recovery payloads.

name: undo
description: Reverse the specified recent work using actual change evidence and available recovery paths.

name: advisory
description: Use platform notes, Flow activation, impact and evidence helpers without changing the org.

name: qa
description: Select and execute useful QA surfaces for the change, with explicit coverage and gaps.

name: qa-browser
description: Run a selected browser journey and verify its actual user and side effects.

name: qa-multiprofile
description: Test the selected journey for configured users and compare role-specific behavior.

name: qa-sanitize-replay
description: Scan a replay script for credential patterns and report masked findings.

name: qa-token-grant
description: Explain or manage an explicitly requested legacy QA skip token.

name: qa-token-show
description: Inspect an optional legacy QA skip token without affecting ordinary work.

name: qa-token-revoke
description: Remove an optional legacy QA skip token when requested.

name: revert-show
description: List available operation snapshots and their actual recovery state.

name: revert-preview
description: Preview a specific restoration against current state without executing it.

name: revert
description: Restore a supported captured operation and verify the resulting state.

name: revert-discard
description: Mark a selected snapshot abandoned while keeping its recovery artifacts.

name: lesson
description: Save a scoped lesson from supplied content or the current session.

name: lesson-show
description: Read relevant saved lessons and distinguish active, pending and archived records.

name: lesson-helpful
description: Mark a specific saved lesson useful and retain its original evidence scope.

name: lesson-stale
description: Mark a specific lesson outdated while preserving its history.

name: collect-lessons
description: Curate selected lessons into reusable knowledge without merging private client facts.

name: session-save
description: Save a concise factual session delta and artifact references for the next session.

name: session-resume
description: Resume a client task from durable records and fresh operational checks.

name: export-session
description: Export selected session work as an internal record, client update or change log.

name: handoff
description: Produce a resumable handoff from the client history and current task evidence.

name: discovery
description: Carry discovery from stakeholder input to implementable requirements and an agreed next step.

name: requirements-to-build
description: Turn a stakeholder requirements note into user stories, a metadata list, a test script and open questions.

name: training
description: Create a practical end-user or administrator guide for the configured workflow.

name: release-notes
description: Write technical and client-facing release notes from verified change evidence.

name: process-meeting
description: Extract a recording timeline and turn supplied meeting material into decisions and delivery work.

name: logs
description: Analyze supplied Salesforce debug logs and relate findings to the reported problem.

name: probes
description: Generate adversarial Apex test scaffolds and guide their validation and execution.

name: update-torque
description: Update the actual Torque installation while preserving private context and local source work.

name: update-jsc
description: Continue the old update command name through the Torque update workflow.
